scripts.text: Oh, no wonder! The network stopped working suddenly. The repeater is not functioning! Then why isn't Alpha coming?
Alpha is busy right now.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Alpha is too busy to come? No way. Oh, were you trying to help me voluntarily? What an unusual guest. Come to think of it, there was a^0000CDcustomer like that before^000000.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text:
I'm sorry.
The guest who visited the mansion showed interest in the mansion and us automatic dolls, but there were no guests who helped us around the mansion.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Anyway, If we have a lot of guests, they'll be coming to eat soon. I've got to prepare. It's been a long time since I've had guests.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: I haven't had any guests in the restaurant for a long time. I had no customer when I was cooking. The intruders... when they got here. My eyes change and I took them away. They were not guests.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: The invaders didn't last long, but they threw the mansion into chaos in that brief moment. They took the machines in the mansion, the automatic dools, everything that seemed useful to them were removed out of place.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: That repeater over there must have a ^0000CDbroken communication chip too^000000?

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Damn humans. Most of them seems to have run away by now, but there are still some left. I've seen them here a few times. They're after the food.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text:
Again, I'm sorry.
Now that I see it, I don't know why I mistaken you as an intruder. You're different.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Anyway, I have to fix the repeater. Let me see...

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Well... the communication chip was ripped off! I'll have to put it in. Where should we get it right now? I have to greet guests?

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Ugh- There's another broken one over there.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: {0}. Can you catch that? Can you do it?
A broken automatic doll?

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Uh. All communication chips are standard, so if they're replaced with a new one. I think it'll return back to normal.
Uh...

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Why do you look like that? Is it because you're reluctant to hurt an automatic doll in front of another one? Don't worry about that.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text:
We need to repair it anyway, but we need to capture it first.
You can think of it as saving the trouble for us automatic dolls.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text:
If you leave it alone, it will wander around the mansion and destroy it, so you'll have to deal with it quickly as you can.
It's better to capture it, then take out the chip and use it to fix the repeater.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text:
Everyone has been doing that ever since the intruders showed up. Even if {0} doesn't do it, it's all up to us automatic dolls.
It's nice to work a little bit.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Please take care of the Broken Beta and bring ^0000CD1 Automatic Doll Communication Chip^000000.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: What about the communication chip?

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: You haven't yet? Are you reluctant to hurt an automatic doll? Don't worry about it. I will do it later on anyway.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: I'll take care of the broken automatic dolls, just bring ^0000CD1 Automatic Doll Communication Chip^000000.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Did you bring it? Give it to me. I'll fix it. Thank you very much for bringing it.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: By the way, is that the only broken repeater?
The pavilion and the garden...

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Oh, really? Then go ahead to the <NAVI>[pavilion]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI> first. It's the closest one here. Just follow this road over here.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Don't touch the broken repeater carelessly. Tell the nearby automatic dolls over there and they'll take care of it.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Do you happen to have a Barmeal Ticket? It's use to eat at the restaurant. I'll give you this, so come and eat later! I'll prepare a good food for you! As thanks!

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Go ahead to the <NAVI>[pavilion]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI> first. It's the closest one here. Just follow this road over here.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: Don't touch the broken repeater carelessly. Tell the nearby automatic dolls over there and they'll take care of it.

scripts.speaker: Tasty
scripts.text: What should I make today... What should I do to make it taste good?

^008800Wait a sec!!
You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000
There's no one here...? What should I do with this? Is the automatic doll communication chip broken again...?
What if I open this...?
Argh!!!! My hand!!

scripts.speaker: Worry
scripts.text: This...! What a mess! Here we go again! It wants to fight.

scripts.speaker: Worry
scripts.text: Get out of my head right now!
Over there...

scripts.speaker: Worry
scripts.text: Are you trying to control me?

scripts.speaker: Worry
scripts.text: This little thing! I'll dispose of it!

scripts.speaker: Worry
scripts.text: Are you trying to take over me?? Just try!!
What should I do? Should I just go?

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text: Phew- Here you are. Why do you keep escaping? Calm down for a bit.

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text: Anyway, who...? An intruder? ...Is it not?

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text: Oh, you're a guest, aren't you? Those who come and go in front of the pavilion are also guests.

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text:
But that's weird. If you're a guest, I would recognize you in an instance.
You are not an unregistered guest, you're a regular guest here.
They can't share it because of the repeater.

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text: Oh, it's because of that! Everytime time I find something broken, I'll repair it, but as you can see, even if I take my eyes out for a moment, Wary comes out and break it like this.

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text: Oh, did our hawk bit you? It's been going on since he was attacked by the ^0000CDintruders^000000. I already fixed it before, but Wary always come out and does this...

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text:
There are a lot of dolls that became like this.
They will return to normal if you fix it, but there are so many dolls that we are a hard time fixing all of them.

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text: I heard the hawks wander around the mansion and ruin it.

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text: I'm sorry to interrupt you at your break. Please enjoy this area of the Varmundt's mansion to your hearts content.

scripts.speaker: Worry
scripts.text: How can this thing be this lively.

scripts.speaker: Worry
scripts.text: You, are you going to get out of my head or not? If you won't then I'll go out!

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text: Hey, hey. Why are you opening the repeater?
Oh, you need to fix it quickly.

scripts.speaker: Worry
scripts.text: What the hell are you? Are you pitying me?

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text: Hey, this person is not an intruder. It's our guest. Let them enjoy here in the mansion.

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text: I'll fix the repeater quickly. Wary will surely come out and destroy it, but don't worry we can fix it again.

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text: Thank you for letting me know in person. Here, atleast, take this. Are there any other places where it doesn't work? I don't think there's only one or two places.
The garden in front of the mansion.

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text:
Oh, it's not working there either.
Go up from this road and turn left to go to the <NAVI>[central garden]<INFO>ba_maison,245,206,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Kimchi
scripts.text: Come on, Warry. Let's go back.
The doll told me to go up from this road and turn left to go to the <NAVI>[central garden]<INFO>ba_maison,245,206,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: If this is the last one, please report back to <NAVI>[Alpha]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text:
May I help you?
This place is accessible only to authorized personnels.
Please return to the entrance.

The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: Hello, adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text:
Don't come any closer.
This place is accessible only to authorized personnels.
Oh, I am...

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: I'm not concern about that. I don't need to know anything about you. This place is restricted. Raise your hands and don't come any closer.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: Don't even think about using weapons, I'm way faster than you are. Where did you come from?
The sewer, but I...

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: So you came from the sewers, huh. Then stand still until I hand you over to the security.
I'm a guest at the mansion.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: A guest? If you are one I would have known.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: I will check it for a moment. Don't move from your spot.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: Oh, you're a real guest aren't you? You're a special guest who has permission to access all areas... I apologize for my mistake. Please excuse me.
I can't believe it. You suddenly attacked me.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: Attack? Did I attack? I only responded according to the intruder response manual. Oh, did you felt like you were attacked?
No...

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text:
Once again, I apologize for my mistake.
Recently, we guards are more suspicious and sharper because of the intruders. Also, among the them there is a man with a low profile that appeared and resisted strongly.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: By the way, how were you able to get permission to access all areas? Normally, ordinary guests can only use non-restricted areas.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: If you were such a distinguished guest, I should have received your information much earlier.
It's because of the repeater.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: The repeater? The repeater here is working fine...

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: Wait, this isn't a signal problem, suddenly there's a ^0000CDhacking channel^000000 jamming it... right?
Hacking?

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: Knowing that the automatic dolls in the mansion send and receive signals throught the repeater. Sometimes, people ^0000CDhack the repeater^000000 to try to control the automatic dolls or to keep track of what's happening inside the mansion.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text:
There are still intruders left inside the mansion.
I must search thoroughly.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: Previously, the intruders were alerted because of a guest who wandered around the mansion, thinking there were no such guest int the mansion.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: But that doesn't change the fact that they're intruders. Unlike the previous guest who were just curious, they infiltrated the premises and commited all kinds of violence in the mansion. Don't you think they're like a thief?

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: {0}, If you don't want to be misunderstood by the other automatic dolls in the mansion, especially in the vicinity of restricted areas, you should identify yourself in advance.
This is the last.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text:
Is that so? Then I'll have to hurry and the repeater, please excuse me.
Also, it's not much but please accept this as an apology.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: If this is the last one, please report back to <NAVI>[Alpha]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>. Also... Welcome to the Varmundt's Mansion. If you need assistance, feel free to ask any automatic doll.

scripts.speaker: Gabriel
scripts.text: If this is the last one, please report back to <NAVI>[Alpha]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text:
Can you meet Alpha first and then come back here at the teahouse?
It seems that the first thing you need to do here is register yourself as a guest.
- A preceding quest still exist. -

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text:
Dien, please check the authenticity again.
This is a document that the goverment examined when the mercenaries stayed here at the Varmundt Mansion.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
Well... even if tried to check the authenticity many times.
I'm not sure to what extent our cooperation will go.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: I'm a bit tired of saying the same thing over and over again.
(The mood looks bad, Let's observe for now.)

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text:
If you take a look, you'll be to understand this evidence.
It's a proof that the goverment tried to talk to the mercenaries, but they didn't respond to it.

scripts.speaker: Ridsh
scripts.text:
That kind of talk never happened! Not a single soul from the government came to talk you know?
I already said no, how long will you keep asking me to find out the truth like a parrot?

scripts.speaker: Ridsh
scripts.text:
It's the same when you brought us new documents, you're lying!
You've been lying to us several times already!

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text:
Why would you think that we'll deliberately use false documents...!
Ah, {0}, since when have you been here? I've shown you a shameful side of me.

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text: I'm talking with the Rebellion <NAVI>[Elders]<INFO>ba_in01,203,103,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>, but it's difficult to verify events that happened in the past...

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text: I'm talking with the Rebellion <NAVI>[Elders]<INFO>ba_in01,203,103,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>, but they're quite stubborn, perhaps because they're already seniors.

scripts.speaker: Ridsh
scripts.text: Hey! Who are you calling seniors?

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text: Adventurer, please go to the managers of the mansion and find out what happened about the time when the mercenaries stayed here in Varmundt Mansion.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
If you're looking for a high-quality tea, this mansion is the place you're looking for.
The tea that I'm drinking in Einbech is not bad, but it's incomparable from the tea here.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: Hmm... Hey, gentleman from the government. Why do you keep asking for evidence when you don't believe what we're saying?

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: Let's bring a false documents to the mercenaries and ask them to prove every mistakes. We can't say anything about that.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
It's a waste of time.
I'd rather find another way, instead of wasting my time doing something contradictory.

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text:
... what else could there be, other than to examine the records and write report.
Are you saying that you can't believe goverment-made report unconditionally?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: For a minute, could you listen to me?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
The question is, isn't it the credibility of the record itself?
No matter how much we use that record with mixed opinions, we won't be able to reach an agreement.

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text: ...as a result, this happened.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: So instead of relying on the government records, why don't we investigate the events that really happened here?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: This place is the base of the Mercenaries War, If you investigate it with your own eyes, you might see things you haven't seen before.
It's a good idea.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Well, who can remember exactly and vividly what occurred here?
The Mansion Manager.
The Cleaning Robots.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Adventurer, cleaning robots only response to what people say.
Ah, yes. The mansion managers would remember it!

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Yes, the Varmundt Mansion Managers! It's not human, but it probably a more neutral source of data.

scripts.speaker: Ridsh
scripts.text: Lucky, Why aren't you listening to us and taking the government's side?

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text:
It's a reasonable way. But who will witness it?
If I said I would, you wouldn't believe me.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: If the government is asking me to believe the lies they've been building until now, then I can't cooperate with you.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: How would you know if the government really tried to talk to the mercenaries, also how would you know that the mercenaries rejected it. You're just bringing us evidence that none of us have know.

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text:
The elders wouldn't even go out to investigate themselves...,
Adventurer, you're the only one that the elders will believe.
I'll get their permission.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
I can believe what the adventurer done so far.
Will you listen to the managers for us, adventurer?

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text: The existence of the adventurer is very important to both parties and invaluable in this place where various enemy forces are in motion.

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text: Adventurer, please go to the managers of the mansion and find out what happened about the time when the mercenaries stayed here in Varmundt Mansion.
Accept.
Refuse.

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text:
Are you busy or it's just a bad time?
Don't you like what I asked you to do?
I can't force you to do it.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
Thank you, adventurer. It seems you're left with the troublesome work again.
I look forward to the truth that is given by a neutral party.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
Thank you, adventurer. It seems you're left with the troublesome work again.
I look forward to the truth that is given by a neutral party.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
The managers knows the truth about the mercenary war.
They're all automatic dolls, they will have a vivid memory and they won't tell lies.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Please listen to the stories of those days, adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Have you heard enough from the managers?
Now, tell us about the facts that you've heard.
Tell the story of the mysterious body.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: There is a body suddenly, What do you mean?

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: It is said that the body that was found was not of the mercenaries, mansion's staff, or part of the corporate... Do you have any specific information?
Hand over specific data.

scripts.speaker: Ridsh
scripts.text: This person doesn't really look like a mercenary. Why would a person like this be near Varmundt Mansion and be killed?

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text: Wait... Show me the data too.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: Is there something bothering you about this data?

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text:
We know who this person is.
This person is one of the commissioner the government sent to the mercenaries for the negotiation.

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text:
It's said that the commissioner didn't come back after being sent, the commissioner was later presumed as a missing person.
But, later found dead in the Varmundt Mansion.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: So, you're saying... A government official who went to see the mercenaries, was killed before even meeting the mercenaries...

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: This, who did such thing.
The Enterprise.
The Government.
The Mercenaries.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
...There is no evidence, adventurer.
Your words gives me heartaches.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: We should talk more carefully.

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text: Why would someone from the government kill the one they sent?

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text: Even if it's the government's opposition, it would have been difficult to commit murder without escaping the eyes of the mercenaries' and workers inside the Varmundt Mansion.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: No, the mercenaries didn't even know it was a person from the government. Even the body was found late.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: It wasn't the mercenaries.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
It would have been a difficult to avoid the eyes of the mercenaries' and workers in the Varmundt Mansion.
But, the mercenaries are not the culprit.
It's probably the mercenaries.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: Are you saying that we're lying? Even after listening to the managers?!
There must have been a traitor among the mercenaries.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
I'm sure there's enough evidence for you to say that.
Now, show us the evidence.
H's suspicious behavior.
Evidence of internal communication with the enterprise.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
... But there's no evidence.
Right now, we can't rely on suspicions. We need proof, adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text: Thats... No, it's an envelope with the corporate's seal on it. It's badly crumpled. Where did you get this envelope? It's an item that's strictly forbidden to leak outside of Rekenber.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
Look at the contents of the envelope. That's what's important.
It's been a long time since I've last read, but I can read it perfectly, like it's a command book.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: I've asked someone to 'dispose' of the government personnel to prevent contact with the mercenaries... And I told him to break inside Varmundt Mansion and steal Varmundt's research data...

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
It's signed by the recipient, 'H. Luckenberg
It's a proof of the identity of the traitor that you mentioned.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: Corporate representative, You don't look so well.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text:
...I need some time, I have something that I want to check.
I'll get in touch with my secretary, please continue without me.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Adventurer, Hey. Mr. Kaya was quite depressed. do you mind checking on Mr. Kaya?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
It's always for something bad to happen at times like this...
I'd be reassured if could take a look at the <NAVI>[garden]<INFO>ba_maison,103,92,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Ridsh
scripts.text: I hope you're not thinking that we're stuck.

scripts.speaker: Ridsh
scripts.text: Is there anything else suspicious about the mercenary?
Tell about various suspicious activities.

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text:
From the mercenaries' perspective, he was suspicious.
However, it seems only a few people knew about it, and they believe each other, so the whole thing was not revealed.

scripts.speaker: Ridsh
scripts.text:
That's entirely the mercenary's mistake.
I would have known if I had a doubt and poked more into it.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
If we found out more about 'H. Luckenberg' at that time...
The Mercenary War might have ended differently.

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text:
I'm glad to know the truth.
The government offered an aid, but they were stopped by the companies...

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
I apologize for not listening to your plead.
You weren't making false evidence. You just didn't know the truth.

scripts.speaker: Tess
scripts.text: I also want to apologize, for not believing your side of the story and forcing the evidence that we have brought.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text:
..........
I'm sorry for leaving suddenly.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text:
Something came in to my mind, and I checked it.
I'd like to tell you something what I have found out on my side.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: What is it?

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text: On the corporate's employee directory... there is someone who has an exact match of H. Luckenberg's activity during that time.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: I see.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text:
He was recorded as a returning employee from a long business trip during the mercenary war.
However, the place he went to was not documented.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text:
My secretary, Grey, searched through an incomplete records and found this note among the remaining work log memos.
'As fast as possible (Traces of erased memo) lead them to the mansion'

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text:
The subject of the memo is vaguely written but it can be clearly understood.
That, he was in Varmundt Mansion...

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
So that's what happened.
The government and mercenaries have been played by the companies again.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text: It's a shame...

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text:
All contextual, and material evidence evidence leads to the corporate.
This is, really, a shame.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text:
I am sorry.
As the Vice President, I feel responsible for all of this.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
Well... Mr. Corporate Representative, what's the difference between you feeling responsible at this point?
If you apologized, will it bring the dead back?

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text: I will take full responsibility for everything, starting by not forgetting the past.

scripts.speaker: Ridsh
scripts.text:
The past? No. It's about what's happening now, the present time. Those Rebellion kids and those who are still sick at Cor are happening now.
Everything you say of the past continues to this day.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: What are going to do now? You can apologize as much as you want. But it's hard to change people's mind.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: Let's stop talking about this now. I don't want to talk to you anymore if you continue to repeat the words of taking responsibility without even saying what you're planning to do.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text: But, Elder........

scripts.speaker: Cotnes
scripts.text:
When you talk proudly like that, it's better not to do it pitifully.
Hohoho, Then I'm off too.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text: Recently, I'm thinking for a lot of things.

scripts.speaker: Cotnes
scripts.text: I don't have the luxury, to listen to your stories.

^008800Wait a sec!!
You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000

To think you're really going to take out the liver and gallbladder for everyone.
The corporate is ashamed of you.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text: Who are you. Why are you hiding in a place like this?
Vice President, I'm with the Rekenber's Board. ...... You don't need to know my identity.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text: You rude...! This is not a place for anyone to come and go. Why did you sneak and look for me?

The corporate is worried about the Vice President's action. How long are you going to be swayed by their eloquence? What would you do if a representative of the corporate repeatedly acts againt the interest of the corporate?

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text: Act against the corporate's interest, I'm always working for the benefit of the corporate.

Let's pick one. Excessive promise of compensation for an accident, overestimation of corporate responsibility.
You're hurting not only the corporate's finances but also its reputation.

Why would the corporate compensate for an accident caused by the Illusions?
Rather, it should be the corporate that should receive compensation.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text: Is there a problem when I promised the welfare benefits of the corporate to those who we hired and working under the name of the corporate?

You're giving too much benefits.
At this rate, more and more people will want to extort money from the corporate for various reasons.

scripts.speaker: Kaya Toss
scripts.text:

Um, yeah. What's the big deal?
You've been having a hard time since last night.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: I told Alpha that the analysisable data in the current state is over.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
Yes. I have sent the data.
Currently, there is no reception from the master's collection 3, but we have caught some unusual signals.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text: This facility has not been used for a long time, but it has been secretly used by the 'intruders' and...

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
There are traces of magical communication with certain places outside the mansion.
It's an intermittent signal.

scripts.speaker: Erst
scripts.text:
What, do they keep in touch with the outside world regularly?
Where? the enterprise?

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
According to the analysis, it's a one-way reception.
It appears to be collecting reports from the outside...

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text: It will take some time to completely analyze the code because it was used by the 'intruders' for one-way reception.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Then, Elly, I'll ask for one thing.
Continue receiving the signals as if the 'intruders' leader is still here.

scripts.speaker: Erst
scripts.text:
That's a smart move, Rookie.
With that, we'll be able to trace back the other collaborators out there.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
I will do as you say.
We will maintain information patters of the 'intruders' and collect information received from their accomplices from outside the mansion.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: If we're lucky, we might be able to locate the airship route that the 'Illusions' used to ran away.

scripts.speaker: Erst
scripts.text:
So we really didn't catch the 'Illusions' here after all.
Except for that kid.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
We protected the mansion... Can't we be a little bit satisfied?
Tess seems to be working hard on coordinating with the companies, so that's all for us.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
As always, you did great.
We were close, but next time we'll catch the rest of them.
I've been collecting these, I'll let you have it, adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Erst
scripts.text: I'll stay in the guest house, if you need anything, come over there.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Then I'll let everyone and help Alpha.
Take good care of Elly!

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
Do not worry about this place.
Me and Almond will take care of it.
You can be rest assured.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
No regular signals have been received yet.
We're also tracking the whereabouts of your collection #3.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
No worries.
Time is on our side.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text: We'll properly analyze the information, so it would be great if the guest could clean up the remnants left behind... Oh!

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
Just a moment, please stay here.
It'll be over soon.
Time is on our side, right?

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
Wait a minute...
...
...

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
Once we decrypt the code, it'll be quick.
The longest part is over, so it feels like it went by in a flash.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
There is something in ^0000FFRachel^000000.
Of course, I've only heard of Rachel, and I've never been there.
The 'collaborators' at that location seem unaware of their leaders' movements as of yet.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
Although we still don't know the whereabouts of Master's Collection No. 3, we need to continue to gather information coming in from here...
What should we do?
What?
What should I do?

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
The location of the collaborator has been roughly secured. According to the report, they are awaiting further instructions, so...
In that case, we should thoroughly investigate that area before the next instructions are given...

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: Okay, so Rachel...

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Rachel... Who's going?

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text: Are we having a difference of opinion?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Not really...
I think it would be a little awkward if we all went.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
Ah, I see.
Yes. If the Rebellion moves, it could become a diplomatic issue.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Yes, even more so if it's Rachel.
...and the problems between the mansion and the company haven't all been solved yet.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text: I see.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text: If so, then...
Why are they looking at me?
What do I do?

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text: Let's go, Rachel.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
But the other guests have affiliations, don't they?
It will be difficult if there is a conflict due to jurisdiction.
You don't know how long it will take, so it's not a good idea to accompany them.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: That sounds like you're saying you're definitely going to go in person.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
Yes, it is.
Please wait a moment.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text: You're authorized.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
The purpose is not to hinder but to support.
We'll follow along, no pressure.
I will give this to you.

What Elly gave was a doll that looked exactly like Elly and felt a little stretched out.
It may not be Elly, but...

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
We also have equipment capable of long-distance data transmission and reception.
Because that's who we are.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text: But things are a little different now, so I'll give you a beta version.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Uh... Mini Elly?

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
Great, I'm adopting that name.
I can collect information like vision and hearing and communicate like an avatar using my own resources.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
There are no individual cores, so the information I get is not shared between betas unless I update it,
If communication is lost, it's just a puppet.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Then call us if you need our support.
I will support you without reservation, just like Elly, except for manpower.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
Yes, I will do that.
Please take care of yourself.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
The nearly exact coordinates of the signal's origin are...
around <NAVI>[here]<INFO>rachel,182,176,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> or so.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text: Safe travels to Rachel.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
No intermittent signal has been received yet.
The whereabouts of the master's collection 3 are also being tracked at the same time.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text:
Don't worry.
Time is on our side.

scripts.speaker: Elly
scripts.text: Me and Alpha will analyze the information properly, so I'd like you to clean up the intruders remnant.
I arrived with Crux to the Prontera Palace, the palace was filled with a strange excitement.
The people in the hall, were the royal family and nobility of the royal family who we saw before.
At the end of the red carpet, there's a young man who's on his knees with a crown on his head.
He restored his honor by regaining the glory he had lost.
He who once had nothing but misery in his name.
He who only saw the world, last time when he was with me.
Wearing a crown named Glory, while his head towards the earth.
The moment it is declared, a new time will begin.
My heart starts pounding hard at the fact that I'm standing in the middle of the passage of time.
This proved the fact that the path that I've been walking is not wrong.
At the end of a long adventure, that young man standing in front of the throne, was guided by my hand.
Knowing the sorrow of the unchosen, knowing the pain of the past that cannot be reversed.
I knew you'd stand in the way of the future, you're not assertive and knows how to seek help.
You will be a great king.

scripts.speaker: Bell
scripts.text:
I was waiting for your return.
Where should I take you?
Go out.
Talk.

scripts.speaker: Bell
scripts.text: I didn't expect at all that it would turn out like this.

scripts.speaker: Bell
scripts.text: Then, let us go.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
What a surprise guest!
I didn't expect that we'll meet like this.
Thank you for coming despite your busy schedule.
You look good in that.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I feel like I'm wearing someone else's clothes...
I'm still wondering if I can really do this.
I mean, is it really okay?
You'll do well.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
If you say so, then I'll believe in you.
You'll stop me if I ever went astray someday, right?

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I believe you will.
Because you're an upright person.
Also...

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
Feel free rest whenever you want.
After all, you're not alone.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text:
I can only see you for a moment now.
I will have to take over the king's responsibilities soon.

scripts.speaker: Nyhill
scripts.text: So, stay healthy, and if you ever need help someday, I will help you with all my power.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: I apologize, but the bath house is currently closed due to an internal condition, and we cannot assure the reopening time. Please come back later. If you would like a quiet bath, please use the private bathroom provided with your guest room.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: I apologize. It is Varmundt Mansion's policy to keep guests from ^0000CDdangerous situations^000000. Please wait a little longer.

scripts.speaker: Magenta
scripts.text: Let's not keep to what the danger is to ourselves , please let us know.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Sorry, we have yet to figure it out. The search is aimed at investigating the existence of risk factors. Please wait a little longer. Please understand this is a procedure.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: I repeat, you can't go in unless your safety is confirmed. I'll abide your request once I hear from my colleagues.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: We are told to cooperate with the automatic dolls of the mansion as much as possible. But if you don't move at the end, we have no choice but to use force, right?
Rookie? What's going on?
It looks complicated, I'll just pass it by.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Then, we have no choice but to call the guards.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Hmm... What should I do with this?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Oh, the adventurer is here too. If you're here for a bath, I'm afraid you can't use it for a while. Look at that. The automatic doll is blocking the entrance.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: There's a ghost coming out of here. You should watch yourself too.
Ghost??

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
I don't know what it is yet. As you know, the moment we entered the mansion, everyone scattered to check the facilities.
The scout team, who went to check for possible Illusion remnants in the bathhouse, came back dead. There is ^0000CDsomething inside the bathhouse^000000.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: I had to figure out what was really inside, whether it was the Illusion's weird prank, that's why this time ^0000CDGonie^000000 went in. It's perfect to move quietly by yourself.
So why are you here...?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Well... It's been a while since Gonie went in, but hasn't come out yet. If someone with a power like Gonie doesn't come out after the time limit, it means there is a problem.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: I'm here to follow the procedure to find out what's the dangerous something are because I'm certain there are unknown risks. We shouldn't let unknown risks interfere with our mission in this mansion.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: The force that we sent in lost... We should be more careful. And as you can see, they're blocking us.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: I'm sorry, but we're still searching now. When it's over please listen to the results and decide from there.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: There are certain dangers in this mansion now. Whether there is more or not is a very important matter for us.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
We need to check first if the risk is supernatural or it's the ^0000CDIllusions^000000. Can you tell me more? Maybe it's the reason the Illusion came to this mansion in the first place.
Otherwise, it's likely to fall into their hands.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text:
I fully understand what you're trying to say. But the procedure...
Oh! The one who went to search are coming back. Talk to them.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Wrong, you're all wrong. There's no danger.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: There were no guests who were said to have died. Did they really go in?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Were there really no missing person in there?

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Maybe he ran away.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: If so, I would come back earlier. Even if it's not, I'm sure I'll get a contact from a crew, who are scattered around the mansion.
Any guess?

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Among what you have said, the most suspicious is the action of the intruders.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Shrine, isn't that it? The long dark green ^0000CD hair^000000. It appeared a long time ago.
Hair?

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Literally as Boiler said. Since from a very long time ago, unknown hair was often found. Perhaps the hair and the unknown dangers of the bath is the same.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text:
I think it's better to let the human guests in and search themselves.
We didn't sense the unknown danger and we failed to locate the human guests. Perhaps because we can't feel like humans do.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: You're right. Human being have senses. Maybe we'll find we missed as an automatic doll. Maybe this time we'll be able to identify whose hair is that.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: We've heard the characteristic of the missing persons, but I'm sure the human guests are likely to recognize them better.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text:
......that makes sense. All right.
From now on, we will open the bathhouse to our guests. Please pay special attention while conducting the search, as there are circumstances and testimonies suspecting the existence of unidentified creatures.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: If you see a monster while inside the bath, please don't rush to make contact with it and tell the dolls around you. Please let me know if you need any help finding the missing persons.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Then, I'll take you inside.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text:
Well, before we enter, I'd like to ask you one thing.
The skills such as ^CC0000Water Ball and Aqua Benedicta^000000 are prohibited in Meditatio, the grand bath.
I ask for your understanding.

scripts.speaker: Magenta
scripts.text: There's... you know, Lucky. Um... um... don't get me wrong. Wouldn't it be better if Lucky stays here?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: What are you talking about? I'm good at finding lost items. I may not be good enough for field missions, but I can atleast protect myself. You don't trust me that much?

scripts.speaker: Magenta
scripts.text: No!! Lucky you're the best! The best!! You know we really can't live without Lucky! But...

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Okay. I'll stay. Then I'll look around the entrance area. I have to check who's going in and out anyway. There's only one entrance to the bath.
I'll come with you.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
It feels reassuring when the adventurer is with us.
Then, come and go <NAVI>[inside]<INFO>ba_bath,165,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. If we find anything, we'll send a signal.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Go ahead <NAVI>[inside]<INFO>ba_bath,165,43,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. If you see a monster while inside the bath, please don't rush to make contact with it and tell the dolls around you.

^EE0000[ ��Caution�� ]^000000
For protection and management of the facility, the grand bathhouse Meditatio prohibits the use of the skills such as ^CC0000Water Ball and Aqua Benedicta^000000.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Hello. Feel free to use the bathhouse to comfortably to relieve your fatigue.

^EE0000[ ��Caution�� ]^000000
For protection and management of the facility, the grand bathhouse Meditatio prohibits the use of the skills such as ^CC0000Water Ball and Aqua Benedicta^000000.

The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Varmundt Mansion's bath house has been famous for a long time. Varmundt is a person who valued taking a rest at the end of an exhausting day.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: He enjoyed bathing as he could relieve his fatigue, get energized for tomorrow, and organize his thoughts, and as he could improve his blood flow and replenish moisture in his skin.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Augmenting the bath house due to his interest in various bathing methods, the bath house has expanded to today's size. The guests to the mansion have used the bath house and have praised its facilities.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Because of that, the mansion's bathhouse became very famous. I hope that you get replenished in this historic bath house.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Please come, your party is already here.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Is everyone gathered? In pairs, follow the procedures for searching dangerous goods and for searching missing persons. Send a signal when you find anything, and the meeting area is in the lounge.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: We should focus on searching for the dangerous goods rather than the missing persons. The identity of the dangerous being has not yet been revealed, and various testimonies and circumstances presumed it's a humans, monster, automatic doll, and supernatural beings.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Denny and Canine. The humans are likely to be individual or groups of Illusion remnants or a third party. There is also the possibility of them using a different exit other than what is known, so check the facilities carefully.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Cyan and Danae. Next is the monsters. Since it's a bathhouse, it's assumed that there are aquatic monsters, or something like them. So focus on the bath and pipes.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: If it's a broken automatic doll, you know this mansion well, so you'll have to listen to the bath managers first. I'll do this one.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Last but not the least, if it's a ghost...

scripts.speaker: Magenta
scripts.text: I know!! I'll take a look! At the ceiling! and drains!

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: ... Okay. Magenta. Go with Molar.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Adventurer meet with the other managers like me to check if there's anything suspicious about the other automatic dolls. I have to get the blueprints first.
Ching

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
I think I should start with this ^0000CDsteam^000000.
It's so blurry, I can't barely see things.
I'll go to the Boiler Room.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Will you? I'll take the blueprints from Shrine here. Adventurer, please go to the <NAVI>[boiler room]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and ask them to shut down. I'll catch up with you soon.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Will you? I'll take the blueprints from Shrine here. Adventurer, please go to the <NAVI>[boiler room]<INFO>ba_bath,286,68,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and ask them to shut down. I'll catch up with you soon.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: I usually go on a mission alone, but this is the first time I haven't heard from him in so long. That's why everyone is looking for him anxiously. Something happened. Think about it quickly.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Even if you say that, I have nothing to say.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Hm? Adventurer? The boiler seems to have stopped, where do you plan on going?
Didn't you say that we should go to the lake?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Who? ... me? Adventurer, did you really ^0000CDsee me^000000?
Come to think of it...

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
The tone seemed stiff and perplexed... That's definitely not me. I guess it's the unknown entity that appears in this bathhouse.
That's quite a headache. I can't believe it can mimic other people's appearance. No, in a way, it's better than that.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Seeing that I told you to go to the lake, I think it was trying to get you out of the bathhouse somehow. So it's not a supernatural being.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Whatever it is, we'll have to settle it before it falls to chaos.
P-peeep-

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Adventurer, let's go to the <NAVI>[lounge]<INFO>ba_bath,203,58,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Your party went to the <NAVI>[lounge]<INFO>ba_bath,203,58,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: How's the search for the creature going?

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Aren't you in a middle of an operation?

scripts.speaker: Shrine
scripts.text: Is there any inconvenience in using the bathhouse?

The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Uhh, human guests shouldn't just come in here. This place is not very durable.
I have something to check.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
Umm... I can't stop you. But be careful with the pipes. It'll melt your skin when you touch it in the wrong place.
But what's the point? We don't have much time.
Please shut down the boiler.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
Boiler? ^0000CDIt's already stopped^000000, right? That's weird. The steam is still coming out? Is the boiler not working? Look at this. I was checking it out while it's on stop.
Is it because the water hasn't cooled down yet? Anyways, I already turned the boiler off.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: I think this will be perfect. Oh... it's not perfect, but it's useful.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Have you seen this a lot on your way here?
No, I've never seen it before.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Um... I picked it up on the way here, and it looked like an automatic doll accessory. There are so many people out there that I thought they were all over the place. I was going to pick it up and repair it.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
By the way, broken dolls are still appearing out of order. Why is that even if we fix broken automatic dolls, broken dolls are still appearing? Is the errors self-replicating?
I can't even clean up properly. But I have to anyway. I have to thank you.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: ... are you not going? I already turned off the boiler. Isn't that why you came here?
Is it an automatic doll?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: What? The monster?

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: I don't think so. Didn't you think ever think we'd notice it first, if it was?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Those things out there are the work of the invaders... They want it to be like that.
What do you think about the monster?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Maybe it's the ^0000CDghost in the boiler^000000.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: What are you talking about?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
The ghost. Don't you know what a ghost is? Do you know about it {0}? It's a something that died, and floats around without a physical form.
What happens here is very similar to what the ghost humans talk about.
Then, the identity of the ghost...

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
Um... I don't it's what you're thinking. Ah~ I thought it was a human ghost. But no, I think it was the automatic doll that used to manage this place before I even came.
It was a small bath boiler at the time, and it was often overloaded with water from so many baths. It couldn't withstand the high pressure.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
Anyways, it exploded while I was working on it, and the other automatic doll was burned down. Maybe it's that automatic doll.
I wonder if that doll's data was engraved in some unknown way. In this boiler.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
This boiler move sometimes on its own without anyone using it, but I think the data from the past automatic dolls remains and continues to carry out commands.
Then it makes sense to hear the sound without form and make noises. You can also see strange shapes because of the steam that comes out.
That's quite scary.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: It's scary. The valve here think it's just a boiler. Is it scary? Valve, look over here.

scripts.speaker: Valve
scripts.text: Beep-

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: The boiler's spectre, do you think it makes sense? It's probably because of a problem that we haven't found yet. But maybe because we are automatic dolls.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: We think that there must be something missing because we can't hear the sounds or feel the signs like the human guests.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text:
But in the end, we didn't even notice the existence of the problem. Problems that we probably won't find because of the limitations of us being a doll.
That's why I suggested to find the problem with the guests.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Honestly, we didn't know what was weird because there were no customers for a long time. Not until the human guests came in, so isn't it reasonable to note the difference between humans and automatic dolls?

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text:
I heard that humans have developed senses and emotions. And the thinking ability to put it all together.
We only collect information and find a conclusion, but humans are different. I've heard you gather all personal experiences, thoughts, and imagination to come up with a conclusion.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: I hope we can solve the problem.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Since the boiler has been turned off. Please tell the <NAVI>[other guests]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to search freely.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Sweep, go meet the <NAVI>[other guests]<INFO>ba_bath,270,94,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. I have to keep my eyes on the boiler. If you find out anything, come here and let me know. Because I'm curious.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: It would be better to look somewhere else than this place.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: What are you curious about? Do you have any questions for us?
Boiler...
About medicinal herbs...

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Medicinal herbs? Are you curious about the herbs that is used in the bath? Why? Is the bath water not to your liking?
I really like it.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Is that why you came here?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Boiler? Are you curious about the boiler? Why? Are you planning to steal the boiler?
Steal the boiler?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
Oh, am I wrong? The intruder was very interested in the boiler and the supply system. They stealed the other boiler without my knowledge.
But. {0} doesn't seem to be interested in it. I was just wondering if you wanted to take the boiler. If i'm wrong then nevermind.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
But what will the intruder do with it? Do you think they're planning on making an open-air bath?
Hmm.. I don't really know what they could do with the boiler. Can you humans make anything out of it? Do you have an idea, {0}?
What else did they do?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Hmmm... I liking soaking myself, but I'm more obsessed with the boiler. They seemed to be interested in the purification facility.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: I was excited to explain about boilers. But I didn't know that they would steal it. I~ really didn't know. Is humans famous for acting on a whim?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: {0}, are you acting on whim too? I don't know much about humans yet. There's a lot to know. That's how I prepare. I won't let them steal it again.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: For example. My master says that it's cool when he soaked in the bath, but when I soaked myself. It's incredibly hot. Did I set the temperature wrong? I did, but it wasn't for him.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: But it's cool. What does that mean? Am I mistaken?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
And then. If you soak these dry leaves in hot water, the contents of the leaves comes out. But it's just that.
But somehow it's good for your health, that's why we fill every bath with herbal leaves. Do humans breath on their skins? Or do you drink water from your skins?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Humans are happy to immerse themselves in the bath. Why is that?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Oh, there's another one! Why do you put ground seaweed in the bath and apply the water on your face?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: I was so curious that I tried it myself, but I didn't know what it was good for. Maybe because I'm an automatic doll?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: If I had five senses like humans, I could have understand humans better. Why didn't the master gave us that?

scripts.speaker: Valve
scripts.text: It's all done. You have to drink now.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: I'm not going to drink. No one's drinking.

scripts.speaker: Valve
scripts.text: Is not ready yet? Can't you just drink a little? Squeeze it out and you'll get a lot of essence.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Valve. Humans are not tea bags. Remember, I've said this many times.

scripts.speaker: Valve
scripts.text: All you have to do is boil the water well.

scripts.speaker: Valve
scripts.text: The temperature needs to be increased to make it better.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: I told you not to touch the boiler.
- Ack! -

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Stop it and come over here.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: It's okay because it's quiet for a while.
It looks dangerous, but the disposal...

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Why waste it! It'll still be useful if we fix it. Who am I supposed to work with if you scrap Valve? I don't like strangers.
Why don't you fix it?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Because I can't leave my hands off the boiler? The intruders broke the boiler and the valves, and there was no time to fix them.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
I'm alone and the boiler room has to be ran by two, but I'm the only one left. There's no time to fix it. I can send it somewhere else, I'm worried that they'll reformat the data.
It's not so serious, I can fix it slowly. Valve is not that bad, it only touches the boiler sometimes. I don't know much about humans, but I know a lot about herbs and boilers.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
But I still have to fix it.
Hmm... {0}? Are you free?
Why?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
If you're free, please help me. I'm short on hands. The valve and the boiler needs to be fixed. But I'm alone and the other dolls are busy.
I wish I were two. Wow... wouldn't it be nice? If there were two of me, this would be the best boiler room.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text:
I'll ask Alpha to clone me. I don't know if it's possible, but logically, it's more efficient if there's two of me.
But, what can I do right now? There's no other me. I should ask for help. So please help me if you're free.
I'll help you.
I have to go take a bath.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Really? Then there's nothing I can do. You also look tired, so I'll send you herbs for recovery. Goodbye.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Thank you. Then, can you handle 20 ^0000CDbroken automatic dolls^000000? I also need 5 ^0000CDbroken automatic doll parts^000000.
Sure.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Yes, then please.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: What brings you here today? Oh, is it for work?
I came to say hello.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Yes, I don't know why you are here. Nothing has changed here. We are still working on the boiler.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Umm... I heard humans break down easily if they work too much. Please go get some rest and come back after dawn.
Let me handle it.
I'l like to take a break today.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: That's weird. I thought you came to see me because you want to get work, right? Well, I understand.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: How can there be such a sincere human? Then, today too please handle 20 ^0000CDbroken automatic dolls^000000 and bring 5 ^0000CDbroken automatic doll parts^000000.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Are you done with your work?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Where is it? We need 5 Broken Automatic Doll Parts. I think there is a hole in your bag. You should check it.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Did you handle the 20 Broken Automatic Dolls? Are you injured somewhere?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Where is it? We need 5 Broken Automatic Doll Parts. I think there is a hole in your bag. You should check it.

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Are you done with your work?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: You've brought a lot. Well, I'll trade it for this barmeal ticket. Thank you.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: What's going on? See you come all the way here, are you here to look at something at the boiler?

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: The boiler is already stopped. Isn't that why you're here? Shouldn't you go and report?

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Is there anything left to see here? Didn't you have something to do?

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: What's going on? Do we still have a story to hear? Haven't you found the all the answer for the monsters?
I'd like to talk to you.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text:
What do you want to talk about? The only thing I can talk about is cleaning. Are you curious about cleaning?
Hygiene is very important here because it's a public bath. Besides cleaning regularly everyday, I do it as often as necessary.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Automatic dolls for cleaning sweeps foreign substances and dirt all over the place. This basic policy is to send all the guests out of the bathhouse when cleaning, but if the guest want to continue taking a bath, we shouldn't bother them and wait.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text:
However, it is not recommended that the automatic dolls that come out for cleaning should not be approached as much as possible because they are dangerous and they're for cleaning purposes only.
Actually, the cleaning dolls wasn't as strong as it is now. The measure was taken inevitably because of the intruders.
Because of the intruders?

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Have you seen the intruder before? When I found them in the bath, my switch for intruder was activated, I didn't let them in. But they came by swarm and forced their way in.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text:
They went through places where you can fit your body, such as water pipes and drains. The fish from the lake are also able to enter through the pipes.
Thanks to them, cleaning became more difficult. The intruder even interfered when I was cleaning. And they didn't even bother helping me clean after.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: This is a bathhouse. Hygiene should be the top priority. The cleaner automatic dolls are strengthened because of that.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: The intruder took a step back however they're not completely gone yet. Therefore, the cleaner dolls had no choice but to remain the strengthened form. So be careful when coming into contact during cleaning time.
Were you interrupted a lot?

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text:
I don't know what the humans want.
However, humans needs to take a bath and the space to do so. The task that was given to me was cleaning. It's all I know.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: There were two groups of intruders. One was obsessed with the bath and the other one is in it's facilites. What they had in common is that they're both obsessed with something.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text:
Humans that are obsessed with bathing did not cooperate with the cleaning, and humans obsessed with the facilities destroyed the facilites and the automatic dolls managing it.
The boiler was ripped apart and stolen, pipes were broken, and automatic dolls are dismantled. The other say they don't know how long will it take to recover from this. The situation in the other part of the mansion is not much different, the entire mansion is in this predicament.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: What is the biggest feature that distinguish guests from the intruders? Why do guests and intruders have different behavior patterns? How do humans tell the difference between the two?

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text:
We, the automatic dolls, think it's natural that we don't know because we've only been in contact with guests before.
We can't feel things that humans can. I can't even feel the touch of the end of my hand.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: But even if I don't know such thing, It won't impose a problem on my work. I can clean. I can carry out the task that was given to me. What is designated as trash should be swept away.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Human beings are human beings, automatic dolls are automatic dolls.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: But... I'd be happy if you could help me with one thing. Are you interested?
I'd be happy to.
I'm a little busy.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: I see. I understand. I learned that I should not take the time of a busy guest.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Then can I ask you to exterminate ^0000CD15 Boiling Piranha and 15 Boiling Marc^000000. They are one of the main cause of the miss in the bathhouse.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Other parts of the mansion are also lacking in hands, so we have to do it ourselves. I clean up whenever I can, but there are too many. It must not be delayed too much because it's about hygiene and safety. Then, please.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: What's the matter? Are you here to help me?
I'm curious about cleaning.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Cleaning is something I do usually. It's just difficult at the moment since there are too many obstacles.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Um.. I'm happy that you're here to help me. But I've heard that humans need a lot of rest. Please come back again after dawn.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Thank you for your help. Then can I ask you to exterminate ^0000CD15 Boiling Piranha and 15 Boiling Marc^000000?
All right.
I'd like to take a break today..

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: I see. I've heard that humans should rest often.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Then I'll let you handle it.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Have you dealt with it?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Did you forgot about it? then please exterminate ^0000CD15 Boiling Piranha and 15 Boiling Marc^000000.

scripts.speaker: Sweep
scripts.text: Have you dealt with it?

scripts.speaker: Boiler
scripts.text: Perfect. Thank you very much. I'd be more grateful if you could come back after dawn.
