scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
This place is dangerous.
Please come back again when you are able to protect yourself better.
- You must be atleast level 160 to perform this quest. -

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Since all places are open to special guests, we can't stop you from coming in here. However, if you're going to look around the warehouse, you shouldn't touch anything here.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
What a mess is this.
How did you come in here?
You don't even have a key with you.
What's this place for?
I don't want to cause trouble, I'll go back.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Maybe you just got in accidentally.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
A human.
In addition... a guest?

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
Did you come here to find the mansion's blueprint?
I'll bring it to you, if you can wait.
I remember the saying, that human lacks patience.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: This is the second warehouse of the Varmundt Mansion.
Warehouse...?

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Oh, is there no concept of warehouse for humans outside? The warehouse is where you store things that you don't use.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: I came here to get the mansion's blueprint and the ingredients for the restaurant. Did you come here in person because you don't trust me? If that's the case, please don't worry.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
I've been in charge of the warehouse for a very long time, I can quickly old or very small items that have been stored.
Needless to say, I also remember where the blueprint is.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: I'm an automatic doll. We don't lose memories.
I'm not looking for a blueprint.
This place is very complicated.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
Is that so? I misunderstood the situation.
I didn't think there would be any humans visiting the warehouse. Usually the humans that come all the way here were usually thieves.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: That doesn't mean that you are a thief. Becayse you wouldn't have qualified as a guest. The Varmundt Mansion does not invite everyone as a guest.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Even if you have that intention, it won't be easy to find what you want here anyway.
This place is very complicated.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
Of course, it's an old warehouse of Varmundt.
It's this big now because there is not enough space to keep all items from all over the continent, that's why we constantly expanded and renovated it.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Although it looks complex from what the eyes see, It's really not that complicated because everything is organized according to it classification.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: This is only possible because it is a very large space unlike what you see outside. So if you're waiting for it, please go back and wait for me... I'll bring it to you soon.
Why?

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: I think I'll be delayed a little because of the broken cleaning robots. It's an automatic robot that was hacked by the intruders. I'm thinking of how to clean the mess it made.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: ^CC0000Setting it on fire^000000 will be the cleanest way, don't you think?
What? Everything will be burnt.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: That's okay. They're all fireproof. Even if it burns everything, the mansion plans are in the other warehouses. We have to go a little far, but it's fine. Rest assured.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: It's fastest and cleanest to handle everything at once.
That's not the problem...

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Then, what is the problem?
I'd rather call the security.
I'd rather call the superiors.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
What do you mean by calling the superiors?
Are you telling me to leave the superiors to solve this problem?

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
It would be fine to call the security, but it would take a lot of time.
Are you fine with that? Security will be in place and it will take at least a day to put them under control and deal with them.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: It's not necessary to waste time passing a problem, when you can handle it on your own, no?

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: However, We are told to respect the guest's opinion as much as possible. Please wait a moment.

scripts.speaker: Beta
scripts.text: You called? What's going on? Is it long? I'm busy right now.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
Look over here. What do you think?
What do you want me to do with all the broken cleaning robots here?
Do you have a good idea?

scripts.speaker: Beta
scripts.text: Oh. It's a serious situation.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
Right? Now, tell me how to solve it quickly.
For the human guest here to hear. Because the guest wants me to call you here for another solution.

scripts.speaker: Beta
scripts.text: The problem is not only in this place. There's no security that I can send here right now.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: I need to get something for the guest here right now. If I go in there now, will I end up broken just like them? Is that fine?

scripts.speaker: Beta
scripts.text: You can't do that, but I can't help you. I'll send you help as soon as possible. But not until tomorrow.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Can I start a fire?

scripts.speaker: Beta
scripts.text:
No. Don't. The broken robot will just move to another place.
Also, we can't risk our guests into such thing.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: I'm confident that I can keep the fire from spreading.

scripts.speaker: Beta
scripts.text: You can't. The more you delay me like this, the slower the process it gets. Wait a little longer. And ask the guest's for their understanding.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Have you seen it? Even if I call my superior, there's no help that will come right now. I can't even proceed with my solution of starting a fire anymore. I could have started it, if you didn't talk to me.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: What should I do now? There's something I need to get from over there, and If I went there, I'll end up broken just like them. I'm not a combat type doll after all.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: I can avoid them to some extent, but I'm worried because there are too many of them. If they attacked all at once, even the strongest dolls will be destroyed in no time.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
Of course, I can go sacrifice myself for this request.
But, I don't think that's not the choice right now. It would be more valuable if I sacrifice myself for something more important.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
Besides, who else would manage the warehouse?
No one even knows what's where.
Should I sort it out?

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
{0}, Are you sure?
Are you saying that you're going to sort out those cleaning robots?
Can't I do it?
You look troubled.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Are you showing pity to me for being helpless in front of the automatic doll in the warehouse? Do humans feel responsible for things they didn't do?

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Is the fault of one human, the fault of all human?
No.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Is that so? That's why we've misunderstood. They're all connected, so they share everything. Both blame and responsiblity.
Varmundt is also human.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
He's different. He's a wise man.
If he's here now, he would have solve all the problems. Or maybe the problem itself didn't occur.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Thank you for your help, but there was a notice telling to cooperate with the guests as much as possible without causing you harm. I'll think of another way. Anything will do.
I'm a combatant.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: ... Is that so? If you're a combatant, you're job is to deal with these kind of things, isn't it? Wouldn't that hurt you?
Not at all.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: I see, you're a human being who finds pleasure with these kind of things. I've heard of it before. Then I'd like to ask you a favor. Oh, of course, I'll reward you for it.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
Please collect ^0000CDFive Cleaning Robot^000000.
Then I'll be able to get through this mess.
I hope you find pleasure on it.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
Are you done? There are still too many of them. I need you to work harder.
Please collect ^0000CDFive Cleaning Robot^000000.
Then I'll be able to get through this mess.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Did you enjoy it? I wonder if you get pleasure from destroying it or pleasure from conservation, But I don't have to know that.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to retrieve the stuffs that we need.
At that level, you can move your body faster than normal.
- Rumbling -
- Rattling -

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Did you hear that?
Is that a rattling sound?

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Yes, that's right. Stay still, and be quiet.
- Rattling -

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: It's the sound made by an automatic doll based on the voice pattern. But it's not a sound of an automatic dolls near here. It's a little bit far from here.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: I think it's from the basement. If it's really from the basement, it's a big deal.
Why?

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Unlike this warehouse, only Varmundt can enter the basement. There are a lot of secrets and dangerous thing there.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
If automatic dolls or human go in and mess with a dangerous object by mistake.
A foreseeable destruction will surely occur.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: If this is really from the underground, and that's a sound of an automatic doll, only destruction awaits us.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: It's only a matter of time before this place becomes ash from the massive explosion. It's a different level from my plan to set it on fire.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
There's danger lurking underground.
Someone has to check it. If you check what happened, we might be able to ask your superiors to come soon. Then It'll be fine.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: We need to do something to stop this.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: I have to go pick up the blueprint and ingredients while the broken automatic dolls is organized.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
{0} is a combatant.
So the rest is...
...to go and check it.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text:
Oh, you would? That's unexpected.
I can't believe you don't do this much security job. I'll keep that in mind. Taking care of guest's entertaiment is one of our job.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: There'a stairway that goes underground in the ^0000CDuppermost part of the warehouse^000000. Go down stairs and check the situation below. Don't touch anything there.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Go ahead and come back when you're done.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: There'a stairway that goes underground in the ^0000CDuppermost part of the warehouse^000000. Go down stairs and check the situation below. Don't touch anything there.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Have you checked? What's the situation underground?
It's locked.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Was it locked? But how did the automatic doll go in? That's even a bigger problem. This proves that there is a hole in the security of the mansion, the intruders also entered through as passage other than the only entrance.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: It would be a good idea to check it... You said it was locked. I can't force myself to get in, I need to find the emergency key.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: It was only for the master, but after going down to the basement, the master left an emergency key that can only be used if something goes wrong with the master or a dangerous emergency.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: That would be know a dangerous emergency.
Give it to me.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: Do you like treasure hunt? Or do you have an exceptional talent for treasure hunting? If not, I hope you'll have it from now on.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: The master hid a ^0000CDtotal of three emergency keys in the warehouse^000000. And there is still a lot of broken automatic dolls in here.
That means...

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: That's right. It's time for you to have fun again. I'm glad to help you like this again.

scripts.speaker: Chirp
scripts.text: You can go down to the basement by finding all the emergency keys at the hints that I'll point out. Use it to unlock the door that goes down to the basement.

scripts.text: <NAVI>[Spinning World]<INFO>ba_2whs01,110,217,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. He said all the truth is beneath it. Try to find a place with such an item.

scripts.text: He also said that in a <NAVI>[place]<INFO>ba_2whs01,110,217,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> where your breath freezes, everything is said to remain unchanged forever.

What do you think? I see... You haven't checked it out yet. I'll be waiting.

How was it? Good thing you came back, I was already thinking of a way to tell Alpha the news that the guest {0} has died.

scripts.speaker: Chirp

I owe you for taking care of me last night.
Are you in charge of this place starting today? I'll clean up well.

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
I am repairing Sweety's broken parts, he is good at breaking them.
He wants to fight often, so you have to be careful~

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
If you want to do a combat training, just tell me.
I'll clean up for you.

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
Sweety woke up. He might know something.
Can you talk to him?

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
Almond didn't understand half of what Sweety was saying.
But a fighting machine? I do remember seeing him fight in the library before.

^0000CDThis is a memorial dungeon.^000000
Please create a party and try again.
^0000CDA party can be created using the /organize partyname command.^000000

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
Are you going to play against Sweety again?
Then, I want to ask you something...

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
Sweety signed up for a battle?
It's fine as long as Almond keep an eye on him.
Also, while on your way, please go out to the garden and pick up the 'cores' of the broken automatic dolls.

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
Sweety signed up for a battle?
It's fine as long as Almond keep an eye on him.
Create '{0}'.
Enter '{0}'.'

^4D4DFFThis place is a memorial dungeon.
You have to be a party leader to create a memorial dungeon.^000000

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text: Let's clean up the mess~

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text: Can you give me time to organize it?

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
Guest, when the time comes, please collect the cores of the broken dolls from the mansion after sunset.
There are still many automatons left in ruins.

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
Are you going to play against Sweety again later?
Then, I wants to ask you something...

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text: Sweetie should be fixed and the automaton should be restored. Almond is busy~

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text: Repairing Sweety. The automatic doll Almond is busy.

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
I need you to collect more than 10 broken doll cores...
You seem a bit short?
Guest, is your effort not enough?

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
This cores is enough~ We'll use it to repair the broken automatic dolls..., and those with remaining data will be fix in no time.
I'll give you this Barmeal Ticket in return.

You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items in your possession.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
His body's base is the same as ours, so it's easy to repair.
I'll tell you, when he wake up later.

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
What are you looking at?
Get away from me?!

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text: Ah. I have a new body...

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
sweety. You are wrong.
It's not a new body, we just repaired your damages. Do you understand?

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
It's amazing that you're compatible with our automatic dolls part.
Alpha said that sweety's body's base is the same as ours.

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
Huh, what do you know.
In short, my body is immortal.
You were a human before, right?

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
If you think outside of the box, all creatures that can talk and rationally are human beings.
But, Me and sweety aren't humans because we don't have any biological definition, am I right? Haha.

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text: What nonsense! I'm a human being! I was human!

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
I was the only one recognized among the bunch of idiots!
Do you know how I survived?

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
Would I have been abandoned like the rest of them, if it wasn't for my genius brain?
But isn't it great that I survived?
It's a nice story...

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
From my perspective... Sweety has a person's brain, right?
His body was modified like an automatic doll.
Does that make you an automatic doll like us~?

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
Don't treat me like I'm the same as you!
I'm a member of the Illusion!
I'm just buying time, I wont fall down easily!
Soon-
Soon?

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
It seems you're mistaken, Sweety.
The leader of the 'intruders' or the one that the guests call the Illusions has ran away, right?
Doesn't that mean that they abandoned you?
That's what I understood from the current situation.

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
Not possible.
You won't be able to receieve it even if it came.
Elly took your receiving chip while we're repairing you.
Doesn't that mean Elly will take the orders for you?

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
What do you think should I do, adventurer?
I couldn't destroy him because this kid has a brain of a 'human child'.

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
You...? What are you talking about?
What are you going to do with me?
My teachers wouldn't abandon me!

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
Can I make a suggestion?
Sweety is expected to express extreme stress due to anxiety.

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
Wouldn't it be better if you deal with him whenever Sweety goes on a rampage?
Then I'll repair him after.

scripts.speaker: Almond
scripts.text:
I've once read a book about a training where the trainer knocks down the trainee whenever they try to get up, isn't it common?
In this case, I'll ask you to be trainer.

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text: ... ... so you won't even listen to my opinions...?

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
I won't fall for your tricks, even if you look at me like that.
Go away. I need to be repaired.

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
I'm fully repaired!
You. Next time I'll really beat you to death!

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
What is it? What's going on?
Did you come back here to die in my hands?
Apply for battle.
Have a conversation.

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
Do you think I'll tell you anything if you do that...?
Why don't you just go and die?

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
I'm glad to hear that.
If you want to battle, you're welcome anytime!

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
But there's a problem. If you want to fight me, you have to convince Almond.
Can you do it?
I can.
It's impossible.

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text: What, you're just a nobody anyways.

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text: *chuckles*... I won't let you live this time... *chuckles*

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
Whoo-hoo... Come on, tell Almond!
I'm going to warm up this body!
And today's the day that I'll take you down!

scripts.speaker: Sweety
scripts.text:
...Tch, I really don't want to see you.
Just take this and go away!

scripts.speaker: Lensis
scripts.text: Users who are not registered as guests are considered enemy.
- A preceding quest still exist. -

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
I just realized, My way of thinking is wrong. This guy called Varmundt isn't he amazing?
To think these beautiful automatic dolls exist. I should've come in more earlier.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: It's beautiful, this form of connection that allows the core entity to freely control sub-objects deployed throughout the mansion with centralized network control method...

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
and yet, it's operating in a way that makes the individuality of the sub-objects stands out.
It's fun. I wonder what kind of machine it works with.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: You seem happy. I don't know what makes you happy though.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Be careful anyway. There's a near toxic sewage running right under this thin sheet of iron.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I guess you can't hear us because you're too absorbed in the new machines and the automatic doll. You're like a kid with a new toy, Ms. Criminal Scientist.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Are you an automatic doll that manages this place? Can I talk to you for a moment?
Don't worry, I'm not a suspicious person.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
It's more like a person than an automatic doll.
What? Wait, the automatic doll looks a little weird. Ms. Criminal Scientist, be careful...

scripts.speaker: Lensis
scripts.text: Recognized. Intruder recognized, initiating immediate exclusion.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Wait, wait a minute. I'm properly licensed... Argh!

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Oh, it's dangerous!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Ugh! Cough, cough, cough!
Argh! What the hell is this? I almost died! I can't believe you did it in such a lovely way. You're all wet!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: You know how to be forgiven for just being pretty, don't you? The world is not that easy! ... wh, what kind of headache is this?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
...... It could have been a disaster.
This person is with us. I'm not an intruder. Alpha said you can communicate with her, but why did you do this?

scripts.speaker: Lensis
scripts.text:
Network check, automatic error correction. Reconfirming packets......
Ah, I confirmed.
......however, more than 62% of the intruders had similar behavior patterns, so I considered you as an intruder.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Where did the 38% went to?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Don't joke like that, Lazy!
You know Mina is no longer an Ilusion.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Wait, I'm a little weird... My head hurts, I'm starting to feel dizzy and nauseous.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
What should we do. The sewage around here is coming for the laboratory, that's why it's almost toxic.
I can't believe you fell into the water that looks very bad even at first glance.
Shouldn't you see a doctor?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
That's a good idea. Adventurer, can you go ahead into the <NAVI>[mansion]<INFO>ba_maison,169,270,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and tell to them to prepare a medical faciltiy?
Me and Lazy will take care of Elyumina and follow quickly.
Leave it to me!
Refuse.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Adventurer, there's no way that you'd think Mina is still an Illusion, right?
Having received the weapons and modules made by Mina herself!

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Thank you, adventurer! I'll be right with you.
Ah, Mina. Her face looks blue, isn't it? Adventurer, please tell them to get ready quickly!

scripts.speaker: Lensis
scripts.text: Hello, guest. Welcome to the sewage treatment plant.

scripts.speaker: Lensis
scripts.text: This area is where the laboratory sewage is discharged into and it's very dangerous for skin contact or ingestion, which can lead to immediate death, so we recommend for everyone to stay away from it.

scripts.speaker: Lensis
scripts.text: If you need a poison, I will provide you......

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text:
Wow~ You're a guest!
Hello. I've been waiting for a guest to come all this time.

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text:
What do you want me to do first? Meal? Rest? Bath?
I'll prepare anything for you. Just tell me.
I need a medical facility.

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text:
Ah, ahhhhhh! Dear guest, are you hurt? Where? How? How much?!
I'll prepare the medical equipments and rest areas right now!
No, it's not......

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Your complexion looks like dirt. You can't walk straight... You will have to change your wet clothes.
I'm sure the adventurer will have the medical facility ready for you to get treatment right away. So, cheer up.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Ugh... it feels weird. Ah, I can see the machine flowing and the river of screws...

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: What are you looking at. I don't think it's normal. Criminal Scientist, are you all right?

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text:
Huh? It's an intruder, an intruder!
Don't worry, I won't let them harm you. I'll call for security assistance!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Oh... I'm feeling a little bit better now. Intruder or whatever. All I have to do is cross that river, ahahaha...

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Wait, wait a minute. She is with us.
We need a diagnosis and treatment. I'd like to ask you to hurry.

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text:
A diagnosis is not needed. I have been told what happened.
You have been in contact with the contaminated sewage that is specially discharge from the sewage treatment plant, haven't you?

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text:
You have come into contact with a dangerous chemicals from the laboratory...
Basically, your life is at risk!

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text:
Oh, You can understand that you're addicted to poison.
Hmm, that's a big deal~

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
'Hmm, that's a big deal~' well, it's not a big deal!
Is there any way we can decipher it?

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text:
Well, dear guest. She's not a guest. You're an intruder aren't you?
We can't give intruders the same benefit as the guests.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Yes, yes. I suppose so. Okay, just leave it alone......
Because if you just leave it, it will die on its own. Goodbye, my beloved machines, I'm going first.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
You talk too badly. Come on, is there any way?
Just because you were an Illusion once doesn't mean you're an Illusion forever. Although you still have to pay for your sins. You have to live with that, too.

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text: You wouldn't be able to say that if you knew how much the intruders had ruined our precious work.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
I have no choice but to use this method.
Alright, ^0000CDas a mercenary who came here as a guest of Varmundt!!!^000000
I want to save this person. Tell me how!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: ...... Why are you doing that? What am I saying? Of course, I'm the Great Elyumina, but you...

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text:
That... If you say that...
You can make an antidote using the ^0000CDLeaves of the Silva Papilla^000000, a material from the water garden. It was raised by the master for that purpose.

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text: But, I don't know if the gardeners will let you enter.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
The information is enough. Because this person's life is in danger! You said <NAVI>[Water Garden]<INFO>ba_maison,239,47,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, right?
Let's go, we'll check it ourselves.

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text: You can make an antidote using the ^0000CDLeaves of the Silva Papilla^000000, a material from the <NAVI>[water garden]<INFO>ba_maison,239,47,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. It was raised by the master for that purpose.

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text:
The hamster in the garden eats anything.
However, you should not attack the hamster.

scripts.speaker: Need
scripts.text:
Oh, a cleaning robot? Of course, some managers call it that, but......
I call it a hamster. I read it in a book. It said that everything that diligently picks up things and puts it in the mouth is a hamster. And, a hamster is cuter than a cleaning robot, right?

^008800Wait a sec!!
You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Damn it... Am I afraid to die like this!
Tch, something that's wet doesn't dry out well.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
I'm dizzy... don't shake me.
I can't go, even if I force myself, I can't go. I'll just give you trouble when I go.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: ...Woah, you cared about that? Ms. Criminal Scientist, this is a surprise.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Shut up! There's no need for consideration for idiots!
I'm resting here anyway. I can't move a leg.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: I need to keep an eye on Mina, so I'll stay here, adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I'm not in charge of combat. So, adventurer, do you have a favor to ask?
Is it fate to go the water garden alone...

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: I'm sorry, adventurer. How about having a party with another adventurer?

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Ugh, I think I lost my mind for a moment and came back to see the end of the world!
Ah, this is driving me crazy. Hey, when's the antidote going to be finished?
Hand over the antidote.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
...... What is this?
Oh..., Is that it. The antidote.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: I'm sorry to make you suffer alone. We should have been there for you.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: ...... you know, thank you.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Huh, I can't hear you well. Speak up, please.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Don't worry, I didn't say that to you!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Yeah, right, why don't you go ahead and try it? It's hard to look over the Criminal Scientist when you're lingering beside me.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Oh, I'm so sick of it...
Anyways, you, {0}. Thank you for getting me the antidote.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: And you... Was it Rocky? Lucky? Anyways, Rebellion, thank you for running around for me.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Like you guys said, I'm not an Illusion already.
I don't feel like I belong there anyway. I only stayed because they supported my research.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: It's different when someone insist on it and others acknowledge it.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Also being hated by such cute, smart, automatic dolls... is not so bad.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I think that's the main point of what I want to say...?

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Anyway, I'm not going to get involved with those idiots again. I promise.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: And if there's anything I can do, I'll cooperate on catching them.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Ah, yeah. This conversation is a little awkward...
But thank you.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
By the way, I'm sure the adventurer had a really hard time coming back from the water garden.
It's not much, but I'll give you some of my meal tickets. You'll take it, right?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Look forward to helping Seihyu in her work. I'll come help when I feel like it!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Adventurer, be quiet! I can't be caught here alone!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: You, if you're going to take away my precious opportunity to talk to the automatic dolls of Varmundt, I'll kill you!

^008800Wait a sec!!
You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
Hello, guest.
This is the docks, but there are no ships operating at the moment.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: your gaze feels cold.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
Welcome, gue......
What can I do for you?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
I'd like to get permission.
Can we enter into the water garden? I have to get a ^0000CDLeaf of Silver Papilla^000000 inside.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
Ah~ She came! You're the one who requested that!
I don't want to help an intruder!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I've been wondering since a while ago, we're in a same group but, how do you distinguish the intruder from the guests?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: There's nothing that says intruder on the face of this Criminal Scientist.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text: We can't distinguish. It's just data collection. Every word you say and actions are datas that we collect.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text: And we compare it to produce the best result. Then we exclude out the intruders, this is course of action from Alpha.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
I want to ask. Why are you trying to save that person?
Isn't she a person who've harmed you too?

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
Is it because you still have a need for it?
Is that what humans do?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Well, that is...
Elyumina is our colleague.
She helped enough to pay back what she've done.
I don't want to kill an enemy or a colleague.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
How come? I'm learning what a colleague is.
According to the definition, she is definitely not a colleague.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Humans being are stupid. That's why I'm doing something different than the beautiful thinking of a machine......... it's kind of miserable but that's my story.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Anyway, a machine with such curiosity, it's so attractive. I want to know more about your way of thinking.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
I excluded you.
Human judgement is also too difficult for me. But thank you for your opinion.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text: Is that so? Did you save her for the reason that she could be helpful in the future?

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Ha, haha... Isn't it similar to an automatic doll?
You are working like this to be helpful, to help people.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
Don't compare us with you.
... but the human standard of judgement, I think are a little bit understable.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
I didn't expect you to say that.
Based on the data collected overtime, human beings are a species that hurts each other if necessary.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
I didn't want to kill anyone.
But they were so weak and stupid that they kept dying on their own.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text: The opinion of the excluded is worthless.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
...human beings are really tricky.
I don't understand your criteria, but I understood them anyway.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
... Okay. If so, do me a favor.
We will give you passage to the water garden, but please help us out in our work.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
Due to the intruders' interference, severals tasks in the water garden have been immobilize.
If you promise to help me with this, I'll open the water garden for you.
Help.
Don't Help.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
Then there's no deal.
As I said before, I have a duty to exclude the intruder.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
It's a deal.
This is just a deal. I'm still aware of my duty to exclude the intruders.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: At this point, I'm starting to feel nauseous. I will definitely make you fall for me.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: You sound like the heroine of a romance novel, but the other person is very vague.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
All right, All right. Whether it's revenge play or a romance novel, we should make an antidote first and talk after you get better.
Mina, can you move? They say it's dangerous inside...

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
...... sorry, I can't overdo it.
It's hard even just to walk now.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Well, then I guess I'll have to stay to keep an eye on Mina.
Adventurer, could you go inside and get the leaves of the Silva Papilla?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I'm a noncombatant, so I'll stay outside. My power is only to protect myself. It's a precaution that I do to keep the pain to a minimum.
I'll be right back.
I'm a noncombatant, too.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Huh? Adventurer... Look back on the battle you've been so far.
And put your hands on your chest and think again.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
I believe in the adventurer.
Please be careful.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Then, we'll be waiting here.
Please go talk to Seihyu again.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
You can speak to <NAVI>[Harad]<INFO>ba_maison,238,44,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> next to me, and enter the water garden.
It could be dangerous to enter, but the adventurer had chosen it, so be careful.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I think it's in and out of it's mind, that automatic doll......

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: The automatic doll is okay though.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
You can speak to <NAVI>[Harad]<INFO>ba_maison,238,44,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> next to me, and enter the water garden.
It could be dangerous to enter, but the adventurer had chosen it, so be careful.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
You've returned in one piece.
Good going, adventurer!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: We've got the leaves of the Silva Papilla, so I'm going to ask someone to create an antidote.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
I can make the antidote.
In the first place, the leaves of Silva Papilla itself is an antidote to several kinds of symptoms, so all you have to do is to change to formulation to make it easier for the guest to intake.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Then... can you make it?

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text: All right. Give the leaves of Silva Papilla to me.
Hand over the leaves of Silva Papilla

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
It's so nice to see smart automatic dolls made by others.
I want to study and analyze... If only this dizziness goes away...

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
I'm not happy from your compliment.
...... Here, the antidote.
Receive the antidote.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
Well, I'd like to ask you to continue helping after you're done with your work.
I believe that you will keep your promise.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Please give the antidote to <NAVI>[Mina]<INFO>ba_maison,234,51,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
Well, I'd like to ask you to continue helping after you're done with your work.
I believe that you will keep your promise.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
Welcome back, dear guest.
Are you here to keep your promise? I have a few things to ask for today.
Silva Papilla Hunt
Grand Papilla Hunt
Missing Gardener
Do not help.

scripts.speaker: Seihyu
scripts.text:
You need to rest a little. Oh, not only you, but the water garden also needs to rest.
